sources.title: GitHub reusable workflows
sources.security_assessment: Caller pins a full public commit SHA and the reusable validator reads PR data without checkout or execution.

reuse_decision.rationale: Reuse the already reviewed public governance validator instead of duplicating its read-only API validation logic in ai-cluster.

verification_plan: Confirm these canonical artifacts are bound to the assigned GitHub PR number and pass the server-side provenance check.
Confirm the existing Python syntax/import smoke CI still passes without any product-code change.
